overview_description.description:
Webville is a social rating engine that aggregates and analyzes content ratings to help users preview the quality of any link on the web.

Webville’s first application is Foodville, the first and largest recipe search engine in MENA. The engine aims to bridge the gap between food content providers and their audience. Foodville offers F&B and FMCG companies a perfect digital advertising channel focused exclusively on their target consumers.
